changelog: **Free-text skills mapped onto the canonical taxonomy, with a review queue (#1819, epic #1810):** `prisma/backfill-skill-taxonomy.mjs` (dry-run by default, `--apply` on deploy after the skill re-split, `--org <id>` to scope) seeds each org's starter vocabulary (insert-missing only), resolves every `User.skills` / `Requisition.requiredSkills` entry through the org's `Skill`/`SkillAlias` rows with the same Turkish-aware fold as the app, and writes `UserSkill` (source `BACKFILL`) / `RequisitionSkill` rows with `skipDuplicates` — a re-run is a no-op and the JSON columns are untouched. Every unresolved term lands in the new `UnmappedSkillTerm` (org-scoped, in `TENANT_MODELS`) with an absolute occurrence count; `GET /api/admin/skills/unmapped` lists the queue and `POST /api/admin/skills/unmapped/[id]` promotes a term to a skill, aliases it onto an existing one or discards it — one guarded transition out of `PENDING`, ADMIN-only, org from the session — and retro-links everybody whose free text carries it. The plain-ESM copy the deploy needs (`prisma/skill-taxonomy-lib.mjs`, `prisma/skill-seed.json` from `npm run skills:seed-json`) is pinned to the TypeScript originals by `scripts/test/skill-taxonomy-mirror.test.mjs`. The queue's screen arrives with `/admin/skills` (#1817).
